description: This file defines a handler for retrieving secrets from various secret management systems, including Azure Key Vault, Google KMS, AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, and custom secret managers. It includes functions to identify base64 strings and a main function `get_secret_from_manager` which abstracts the retrieval process based on the key management system.

methods.name: _is_base64(s)
methods.description: Checks if a string is valid base64 encoding.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_secret_from_manager( client: Any, key_manager: str, secret_name: str, key_management_settings: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a secret from different secret management systems based on the key manager specified.

ctags.name: get_secret_from_manager
ctags.signature: ( client: Any, key_manager: str, secret_name: str, key_management_settings: Optional[Any] = None, )
